::: {#rem-local-decoding}
#### Reading two symbols instead of the whole word

When $\delta \le 1/6$, the success probability $1 - 2\delta$
in @thm-hadamard-local-decoding is at least $2/3$,
so the Hadamard code is [locally decodable](#def-locally-decodable) with 2 queries,
however long the message is.
When $\delta < 1/4$, the decoder is right with probability above $1/2$,
and repeating it with fresh random choices and taking a majority vote
drives its error probability as low as needed.
Decoding to the nearest codeword, as in @thm-distance-corrects-errors,
instead reads all $2^k$ symbols.
The Hadamard code pays for local decoding with block length $2^k$;
polynomial codes in several variables,
which extend [Reed--Solomon codes](#def-reed-solomon-code),
trade a few more queries for much shorter codewords
[@arora2009computational, chapter 19].

:::
